stem: Voltmarkt counts only touches in the 30 days up to and including an order, and credits an order with no such touch to an unattributed row. Order A, €300: paid search 45 days before, email 3 days before. Order B, €500: social 10 days before, and a display retargeting click 1 day after the order. Order C, €200: one paid search click 40 days before. Order D, €150: no touches at all. Under last click, how much revenue goes to the unattributed row, in euros with 0 decimals?
